turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to campus?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Yes, ce bus goes straight to the university. Il s'arrête right by the main entrance.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: How much is a single ticket?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: A single ride costs deux dollars. If you need a transfer, demandez au chauffeur and it is free.
